    Top-seeded
    Duke defeated No. 5 St. John's 80-75 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament East Region Sweet 16 on Friday, March 27, 2026, in Washington D.C.. After trailing by 10 in the second half, Duke rallied behind Caleb Foster’s 11 second-half points and Isaiah Evans’ 25 total points to reach the Elite Eight. 
    Key Matchup Timeline: March 27, 2026 (Sweet 16) 
    • Game Time: 7:10 p.m. ET (Tip-off).
    • Location: Capital One Arena, Washington, D.C..
    • First Half: St. John's challenged Duke early, leading at various points and keeping the game tight, taking a 10-point lead at one stage in the second half.
    • Second Half Rally: Caleb Foster, returning from a foot injury, scored all 11 of his points to spark a comeback.
    • Final Minutes: St. John's trailed by only a few points in the final minute. Dylan Darling missed a potential game-tying 3-point attempt with less than 5 seconds remaining.
    • Conclusion: Cameron Boozer hit free throws in the final 2 seconds to seal the 80-75 win.
    • Final Score: Duke 80, St. John's 75. 
    Key Stats 
    • Isaiah Evans (Duke): 25 points.
    • Cameron Boozer (Duke): 22 points, 10 rebounds.
    • Caleb Foster (Duke): 11 points (all in second half).
    • St. John's Red Storm: Finished season 30-7 after eliminating Kansas previously.
    • Duke Blue Devils: Improved to 35-2 with a 14-game winning streak.
